fusions.name: Hydraulic Ram
fusions.desc: A jet of water under pressure that deals 28 damage and ignores armour, and leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprung Rivets
fusions.desc: Fires 3 rivets from your plating on jets of water, spread apart. Each one deals 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Seawall Stance
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and draws up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quench-Hardened
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you carry 10% fire resistance.
